messages:
oncall-bot: Postmortem published for INC-2026-042 — GPU OOM cascade. Link: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/INC-2026-042. TL;DR: autoscaler + cache growth. Please add owners for action items and suggested timelines.
Alex: I can own autoscaler tuning (action: tune thresholds + add test). target: 2 weeks to deploy, 4 weeks to verify.
Priya: I'll take alerting thresholds and dashboard queries. Will add dashboard screenshots and query examples. target: 1 week for alerts, 3 weeks for dashboards.
Jamal: Suggest we add a recurring check for memory growth pattern across models. Maybe a 3-month runbook review and a perf regression test.
Lucy: Proposal for process: timeline template + comms cadence. Initial ack within 48h, weekly owner updates until fixed, retro within 7 days of incident close. CC product + infra on weekly updates.
Marie: +1 to Lucy. Also propose IC rotation doc — rotate incident commander every 2 weeks, publish a signup sheet. I'll set up the doc.
Alex: I'll add concrete acceptance criteria to each action: how we verify (metrics, dashboards, smoke tests). Also add due dates and owners in the postmortem.
Priya: Can we add SLAs on remediation ownership? e.g., owner acknowledges in 48h, P1 remediated within 30 days unless blocked, P2 within 90 days.
Jamal: Make sure each action has a verification step (regression test / monitoring alert) and a followup date to re-check.
Lucy: Timeline template (paste into postmortem):
```
- Action: short description
- Owner: name
- Due: YYYY-MM-DD
- Acceptance criteria: measurable check(s)
- Follow-up date: YYYY-MM-DD (recur check)
- Recurrence pattern: none / 3mo / 6mo
```
Also: comms cadence snippet: initial thread update (48h), weekly summary in #incidents until resolved, retro invite + summary within 7 days.
Alex: I'll update the postmortem with that template and assign owners now. Adding JIRA tickets for each action. Linking to the deployment PRs.
Marie: I'll schedule the IC rotation doc + calendar and ping ops to join. Also will set up a monthly incident trends dashboard (top recurring root causes).
oncall-bot: Reminder created: weekly follow-ups for 8 weeks for INC-2026-042 actions (will ping owners).
Priya: Can we also add a quarterly audit item to scan for similar incidents across infra? If yes I'll add as action and owner.
Jamal: I'll create the umbrella ticket INC-ACT-12345 and link child tasks.
Alex: Great. Once owners are assigned I'll mark the postmortem status -> "actions assigned" and we can use the tracker. Link to tracker: https://redwood.internal/issues/INC-ACT-12345.
Marie: Thanks all — let's aim to close blockers in the next 30 days and reconvene review in 3 months for recurrence checks. :thumbsup:
